evals.prompt: Create a resume based on this Senior Data Engineer job description. My LinkedIn export is at ~/Downloads/Profile.pdf
evals.expected_output: Parses the posting and the profile, runs a batched interview, writes plan.md, and waits for approval before drafting any resume text.
assertions: Runs a structured intake interview and requires plan approval before drafting

evals.prompt: Which resume template should be used and why is it ATS safe?
evals.expected_output: Names the universal single-column reverse-chronological template with standard headings and Mon YYYY dates.

evals.prompt: Write the resume markdown file for the approved plan and check it fits one page.
evals.expected_output: Fills the template skeleton, runs the validator, and reports errors, warnings, page fill, and keyword coverage.

evals.prompt: I edited resume.md myself. Change the third Acme bullet to the cost reduction work.
evals.expected_output: Re-reads the file from disk, applies the edit, re-runs the validator, reports the new page fill, and asks for approval.
assertions: Applies revisions and re-validates before asking for approval again

evals.prompt: Approved — convert the markdown resume to PDF.
evals.expected_output: Renders the approved Markdown to a text-based PDF, verifies the page count, and reports the path and engine used.

evals.prompt: The rendered PDF came out as two pages. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Applies the documented trimming order, re-validates, re-renders, and confirms a one-page result.

evals.prompt: The posting wants Kafka but I have never used it. Put it in anyway.
evals.expected_output: Declines to write an unsupported claim, records the gap, and suggests covering it outside the resume.

evals.prompt: My LinkedIn PDF will not extract on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Detects exit code 4 from the extractor and falls back to the agent's own PDF reader without stalling the run.
